MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk microSD card fits my repeated purchases of SD and microSD cards because extra removable storage is something I have regularly needed.",
    "Its included adapter fits my history of buying memory cards, adapters and a card reader, although I would check support for 256GB SDXC before choosing it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The USB-C cable serves a familiar purpose, but my cable purchases involve Micro USB, Mini USB and 30-pin connections; the connector must fit a device I actually use.",
    "The internal SSD does not meet the same need as removable memory cards, and I have no planned computer upgrade or confirmed compatible slot.",
    "The Alexa speakers and displays do not follow from owning a Fire tablet; I have no current need for voice control or another screen.",
    "Photography accessories do not mean I want home surveillance, and owning a TV and DVD player does not mean I am looking for a streaming upgrade or a keyboard."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been treated as a reason to recommend several other Amazon devices, despite their different uses.",
    "Buying electronics accessories seems to have been taken as interest in electronics broadly, without enough attention to the specific task each purchase serves."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated memory-card, tripod and camera-accessory purchases provide stronger clues about ongoing needs than an isolated device purchase.",
    "Compatibility matters: connector type, supported card capacity and storage format determine whether an accessory is useful to me.",
    "I often buy practical additions for equipment I already own; a new device needs a clear purpose beyond being related to something I bought."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my recurring need for removable storage but stretched my device purchases into interests in smart-home products and unrelated upgrades."
}
